domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 用于表示信号时频能量分布的双线性分布。
usage_overview: 用于分析振动信号能量在时间与频率上的集中位置及其变化，观察车体加速度等响应的时频特征。这类二次型时频分析方法在处理多分量信号时会产生交叉项。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

P015.title: On use of characteristic wavelengths of track irregularities to predict track portions with deteriorated wheel/rail forces
P015.authors: L Xu, W Zhai, Z Chen
P015.label: Xu等（2018）

complete_examples.text: In the modeling procedures, a time-frequency unification method combining wavelet transform and Wigner-Ville distribution for characterizing time-frequency characteristics of track irregularities and a three-dimensional nonlinear model for describing vehicle-track interaction signatures were developed and coupled, based on which the method for predicting track portions subject to deteriorated wheel/rail forces was proposed.
In the following, wavelet approach, Wigner-Ville distribution, and a unification of these two methods will be briefly introduced, respectively.
